name: Hiiragi Kyouichirou
source:
A young man who came to Tokyo from his home village of Momoki to enroll in the Imperial University. He is kind, but having been taught "nobility obligates" by his parents, he has an inflexible streak that doesn't allow him to turn a blind eye to injustice. 
He is skilled in swordsmanship and brought with him a katana that has been passed down in his family for generations.
He is being pressured into cooperation with the military because he has the ability to see spirits.

"If you insist on keeping this up, I'll become your opponent!"
